gen-gf-barriecito-fs-supreme: Expressive from the first word, Barriecito leans into those tipped-ladle bowls. Supreme, sans-serif and heavy-looking with letters held open, gives the showy heading something sturdy to stand against.
gen-gf-barriecito-general-sans: Distinctive from the first line, Barriecito pours out ladle-shaped bowls and a big lowercase beside compact capitals. General Sans, smooth as bent wire, fills each line with a tall x-height.
gen-gf-barriecito-montserrat: Ladle-bowl curves and a big-bodied lowercase make Barriecito hard to ignore up top. Montserrat, the sans below, glides like wire past oversized counters, with no thick-thin swing anywhere in its letters.
gen-gf-barriecito-satoshi: Satoshi reads tall and open, its e never squeezed shut. Barriecito's ladle-like bowls and big lowercase make a loud partner, and the crossbar and stem of Satoshi's t match in weight.
gen-gf-barriecito-switzer: Barriecito pours open, ladle-like bowls and a big-bodied lowercase across the heading. Switzer follows with tubular, wire-like letters and a tall waist line, so the loud heading sits over a steadier text.
gen-gf-barriecito-work-sans: Barriecito brings tipped-ladle bowls and compact capitals to the heading, loud and full of personality. Work Sans then keeps to a rounded-rod, single-weight build with its mean line set high, which steadies the text under it.
gen-gf-battambang-archivo: Compressed ascenders and open-jawed curves give Battambang a sharp, expressive look. Archivo takes over below with outward-opening curves and a commanding x-height, giving the heading a sturdy, editorial partner.
gen-gf-battambang-fs-asap: Asap comes across readable and plain-spoken, with c forms as open arcs. Battambang's compressed ascenders and open-jawed curves add the drama above, while Asap's lowercase nearly matches its capitals in height.
gen-gf-battambang-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Compressed ascenders, open jaws: Battambang looks sharp and distinctive. Be Vietnam Pro, bent like steel rod with diagonals matching its verticals, makes a sturdy foil, though a small Battambang would lose its open jaws.
gen-gf-battambang-fs-epilogue: Sharp and compressed up top, Battambang packs open-jawed curves beneath short ascenders, a headline with real attitude. Epilogue unspools below, a monoline wire of tall, unclamped curvy lowercase.
